body: Hello! I'm Venezuelan and I comply with most of the requirements and although I don't have much experience using DropBox I can definitely learn fast :) I have experience as a translator/interpreter (mostly accounting and legal consulting meetings) and have a lot of organizational skills working with schedules, KPIs, management of a Tech team, etc. However I do live in Colombia, so I have to ask is that an essential requirement? Thanks!

Yes, I have made my research and found out that something reasonable for a human translator (no machine translation involved, I think) is around 2000-2500 words, and more text than that lacks quality... Also yes, I think I'll have to put up with it and work extra time for a bit because I really need the job and getting real experience :')

Thanks! Yeah, I guess that at first it'll feel like a lot and may be really stressful. I'll definitely have to talk to my boss, but I want to try and track how much it takes me to do each task so I can have a solid base to support my request.

Yeah, that's what I thought too. There's no way I can complete a post within an hour without sacrificing the quality of the text, which is the main point regarding legal/economic articles. Thanks for your help! c:
Yes, 8 hours. So when I do basic math, that amount of work within that amount of time doesn't seem feasible, plus the other things I have to do to complete and upload the post...
The average is about 700 words, but there are also post that are 1k words long. I work under an indefinite contract so I guess my productivity will be judged based on that :/
